questions.question: The Presiding Officer walked slowly to the dais.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adjective'. Explanation:- 'officer' noun hai, aur noun ko qualify karne ke liye adjective ka use hota hai, isliye 'presiding' yahan adjective hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The children were walking through the forest.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'preposition'. Explanation:- 'through' preposition aur 'the forest' preposition ka object, isliye option D sahi hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: I will wait here till he comes.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'conjunction'. Explanation:- 'I will wait' subject + verb hai aur 'he comes' bhi subject + verb hai, toh subject + verb ke pair se clause banta hai, aur do clause ko jodne ka kaam conjunction ka hota hai, isliye 'till' conjunction hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The son writes meaningless letters to his father.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adjective'. Explanation:- 'letters' noun hai jiski visheshta 'meaningless' bata raha hai, noun yaa pronoun ko qualify (vishesta) batane waale ko adjective kehte hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Hurrah! We won the game!
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Interjection'. Explanation:- Wo word jo kisi expression yaa feeling ko bataye unhe interjection kehte hai jaise 'Hurrah!, Alas!, Ouch!, Wow!' etc.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Since he was late, he missed the train.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'conjunction'. Explanation:- 'since' preposition aur conjunction dono hota hai, conjunction mein 'kyunki' meaning aata hai, preposition mein 'jabse' meaning hota hai, yahan do clause ko jodne ka kaam kar raha hai, 'kyunki' wala meaning hai, isliye 'since' conjunction hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Jasmines and roses are my favourite flowers.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'conjunction'. Explanation:- Yahan 'and' conjunction hai kyunki 'jasmines' aur 'roses' noun ko jod raha hai. conjunction 2 same ranking words, clause yaa phrases ko jodne ka kaam karta hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: I will meet you in the third week of August.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'preposition'. Explanation:- 'in, on, into, above, upon, under, of' etc yeh preposition hoti hai, jinke baad preposition ke object aate hai 'third week' preposition ka object hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Identify the type of pronoun: "Their house is not so good as ours."
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'possessive pronoun'. Explanation:- 'ours' ka matlab 'our house' jo ek noun ki jagah pe aaye aur possession bhi dikhaaye unhe possessive pronoun kehte hai, jaise 'mine, ours, yours, his, hers, theirs'.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Rita eats her dinner quickly.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'verb'. Explanation:- 'eats' yahan verb hai jiska form 'eat, ate, eaten, eating' hoti hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Ravi was declared as the winner in the tie because he had hit the most number of fours and sixes.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'conjunction'. Explanation:- 'ravi was declared' subject+verb hai aur 'he had hit' bhi subject+verb hai, toh subject+verb ke pair se clause banta hai, aur do clause ko jodne ka kaam conjunction ka hota hai, isliye 'because' conjunction hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Hurrah! What a scintillating beauty the landscape is!
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'interjection'. Explanation:- Wo word jo kisi expression yaa feeling ko bataye unhe interjection kehte hai jaise 'Hurrah!, Alas!, Ouch!, Wow!' etc.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The building is very ancient.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Intransitive verb'. Explanation:- 'is, am, are, was, were' helping verb ke baad koi main verb naa likhi ho, toh inhe linking verb kehte hai. 'transitive verb' wo hoti hai jiske baad verb ka object ho, lekin 'linking verb' ke baad 'complement' likhe jaate hai. 'auxiliary verb = helping verb'. 'phrasal verb' bolte hai 'verb+ preposition/adverb' ke combination ko. Isliye 'is' yahan intransitive verb(linking verb) aur 'ancient' iska adjective(complement) hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He has offered her another chance.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'perfect tense'. Explanation:- 'offered' verb hai jiska indirect object 'her' aur direct object 'chance' hai, isliye 'offered' di-transitive verb hai. 'has offered' perfect tense bhi hai, agar option mein 'di-transitive' hota toh prefer karte, lekin aisa option nahi hai, isliye 'perfect tense' ko prefer karenge. 'transitive' bhi galat nahi hai, lekin 'perfect tense' 100% sahi hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Identify the non-finite verb: "He tried to warn her before leaving."
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'infinitive'. Explanation:- 'to+v1' se infinitive banta hai, isliye 'to warn' infinitive hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Noticing the change in the behaviour of the officer, the cadets returned to their position.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'participle'. Explanation:- 'noticing' agar verb hota toh iske pehle helping verb aati, agar noun hota toh yeh kisi verb ka subject/object banta, isliye 'noticing' yahan present participle(adjective) hai 'the cadets' noun ke liye. isliye 'participle' sahi hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Driven by hunger, he ate the stale bread.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'past participle'. Explanation:- 'driven' yahan past participle hai kyunki 'he' subject ke liye likha hai, 'v1+ing' jab adjective ki tarah kaam kare toh 'present participle', aur 'v3' adjective ki tarah toh past participle.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The most beautiful actor of the industry was awarded today.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adverb'. Explanation:- 'actor' subject hai jisko qualify 'beautiful' adjective kar raha hai, aur jo adjective ko qualify kare usse adverb kehte hai, isliye 'most' yahan 'adverb' hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The man in dark blue is the one who made us win the match.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'relative pronoun'. Explanation:- 'who, whom, which, that' yeh relative pronoun hote hai aur yeh 'pronoun+conjunction' ka kaam karte hai, 'who' yahan 'made' verb ka 'subject' hai aur do clause ko jodne ke liye 'conjunction' kaa kaam kar raha hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He has been working in the Department of Foreign Affairs since 2002.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'preposition'. Explanation:- 'since' ka yahan meaning 'jabse' hai, isliye yeh preposition hai. agar 'since' ka meaning 'kyunki' hota toh yeh conjunction hoti.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: I can hardly believe it.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adverb'. Explanation:- 'can' helping verb hai, 'believe' main verb hai, aur 'hardly' verb ko qualify kar raha hai, isliye 'hardly' adverb hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The ants fought the wasps.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'transitive verb'. Explanation:- 'fought' yahan verb hai aur iska object 'the wasps' hai, isliye 'fought' yahan transitive verb hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: I hurt myself.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'pronoun'. Explanation:- 'myself' yahan reflexive pronoun hai. wo pronoun jo khud 'doer' aur 'receiver' bante hai, toh objective case mein 'reflexive pronoun' ka use karte hai, isliye 'pronoun' sahi hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The Son got angry when his father asked the question.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adjective'. Explanation:- 'anger' noun hota hai, 'angry' adjective, 'angrily' adverb hota hai. 'got' linking verb hai kyunki iska matlab 'hona' hai, aur linking verb ke baad complement aate hai, isliye 'angry' adjective (subject complement) hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The flower is very beautiful.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adverb'. Explanation:- 'beautiful' adjective hai aur adjective ko qualify 'adverb' karte hai, isliye 'very' yahan adverb hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: It is eleven o'clock now and all of us should retire to bed.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'impersonal pronoun'. Explanation:- 'it, there' introductory subject hote hai jo 'time, date, weather, situation, poore clause ke liye subject, poore infinitive ke liye subject' ko refer karte hai. 'Personal pronoun' wo hote hai jo kisi 'person, thing' ko refer kare. 'it' yahan 'time' ko refer kar raha hai, isliye yeh impersonal pronoun hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He said to him that he was welcome.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adjective'. Explanation:- 'welcome' adjective, noun dono hota hai, noun tab maana jab sense 'he receives a grand welcome' iss type ka ho, agar 'he is welcome, he was welcome, they are welcome, they were welcome' iss type mein ho toh 'welcome' ko adjective maante hai, isliye 'welcome' yahan adjective hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: This is his pen.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'possessive adjective'. Explanation:- 'his' 'pen' pe possession bana raha hai, isliye 'his' yahan possessive adjective hai. 'is' linking verb hai 'pen' noun(subject complement) hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The wonderful statue of the leader welcomes all people to the city.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'noun'. Explanation:- 'statue' yahan subject(noun) hai, aur 'wonderful' noun ke liye adjective hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: All the pilgrims rested for a while under the banyan tree.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'preposition'. Explanation:- 'in, on, under, of, into, above, beyond etc' yeh preposition hoti hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: There was an exultation in the group.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'noun'. Explanation:- 'there' introductory subject hai aur real subject 'exultation' hai, jo ki noun hai, aur 'a, an, the' article nouns ke pehle use hote hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Ravi won the match with a huge margin.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'transitive verb'. Explanation:- 'ravi' subject hai, 'won' verb hai aur 'the match' object', jis verb ke pass object hota hai, unhe transitive verb kehte hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Love your neighbour as thyself.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'pronoun'. Explanation:- 'thyself' purana version hai 'yourself' ka 'as' preposition hai aur 'thyself' preposition ka object(pronoun) hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: This time we woke up to the virus related diseases.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'demonstrative'. Explanation:- 'this, that, these, those' yeh demonstrative adjective hotehai, jo ki noun ko qualify karte hai, yahan 'time' noun hai. 'this time' dono underline hote toh inhe 'adverb of time' maante.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: They have been driving since early morning.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adverb'. Explanation:- Waise toh 'since' yahan preposition hai lekin aisa koi option nahi hai, lekin exam mein isse 'adverb' maana hai, agar 'since early morning' poore pe underline hota toh yeh 'adverb of time' hota, kyunki 'preposition' option nahi hai, isliye isse 'adverb' mark karna padega.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He told me that the teacher gave him a pen.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'di-transitive verb'. Explanation:- 'teacher' subject hai 'gave' ek di-transitive verb hoti hai, jiska indirect object 'him' hai, aur direct object 'a pen' hai, isliye 'di-transitive' sahi hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The man who is in the green shirt is the chief of the day.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'relative pronoun'. Explanation:- 'who, whom, which, whose, that' yeh relative pronoun hote hai, jo 'pronoun + conjunction' ka kaam karte hai, 'is' verb ke liye subject aur clause ko jodne ke liye conjunction ka kaam kar raha hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Alas ! He has been defeated.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'interjection'. Explanation:- Wo word jo kisi expression yaa feeling ko bataye unhe interjection kehte hai jaise 'Hurrah!, Alas!, Ouch!, Wow!' etc.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The most beautiful seven monkeys of the landlord were taken for a stroll.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adjective'. Explanation:- 'beautiful' adjective hota hai aur iski degree hoti 'beautiful, more beautiful, most beautiful', isliye 'most beautiful' yahan adjective hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The preacher said, "No one is above the all powerful".
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'preposition'. Explanation:- 'in, on, under, above, upon, into, onto etc.' yeh preposition hoti hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The secretary himself visited the affected families.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'pronoun'. Explanation:- 'himself' yahan emphatic pronoun hai, jo sentence mein emphasis daalne ke liye use hota hai, jiska use verb se pehle yaa object ke baad karte hai, isliye yahan 'pronoun' sahi hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: She truthfully answered the detective's questions.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adverb'. Explanation:- 'truthfully' adverb of manner hai jo 'answered' verb ko qualify kar raha hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He thought the movie ended abruptly.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adverb'. Explanation:- 'abruptly' adverb of manner hai jo 'ended' verb ko qualify kar raha hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: When he reached the department, the officials had left for the meeting.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'past perfect verb'. Explanation:- 'had left' past perfect tense hota hai, isliye past perfect verb sahi hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: "What is the latest news ?" asked the Captain.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adjective'. Explanation:- 'latest' adjective hai jo 'news' noun ko qualify kar raha hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: This boy is stronger than Ramesh.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adjective'. Explanation:- 'this, that, these, those' yeh demonstrative adjective hote hai, jo ki noun ko qualify karte hai, yahan 'boy' noun hai, isliye 'this' yahan adjective hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: When people found that the jewel was in records of Rahim, they gave it to him.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'pronoun'. Explanation:- 'they' subject hai, 'gave' verb hai, 'it' object hai, isliye 'it' yahan pronoun hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He has been living in the jungle for long and he knows all the animals here.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'coordinating conjunction'. Explanation:- 'For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So' yeh saari coordinate conjunction hoti hai, isliye 'and' coordinating conjunction hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question:
Select the sentence with correct adverb of manner:

Select the sentence with correct adverb of manner:
options: He has just done his work.
He has done his work on my table.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'He does his work carefully'. Explanation:- Question mein adverb of manner pucha hai, toh 'carefully' adverb of manner hota hai, isliye option C sahi hoga, baaki 'regularly' adverb of frequency hai, 'just' adverb of time hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: I know that that black cow is his.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'conjunction, demonstrative adjective, possessive pronoun'. Explanation:- 'I know' subject+verb hai aur 'black cow is' bhi subject+verb hai, toh subject+verb ke pair se clause banta hai, aur do clause jodne ka kaam conjunction ka hota hai, isliye first 'that' yahan conjunction hai. aur second 'that' yahan demonstrative adjective hai jo 'cow' noun ko qualify kar raha hai. aur 'his' yahan possessive pronoun hai, kyunki possessive adjective bina noun ke nahi aapayega, jaise 'his car, her cap, their choice etc.' isliye 'conjunction, demonstrative adjective, possessive pronoun' wala option A sahi hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The cat loves comfort.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'definite article'. Explanation:- 'a, an, the' article hote hai 'a, an' indefinite article hote hai, aur 'the' definite article hota hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Life is a solo fight, and each person makes his or her own journey.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adjective'. Explanation:- 'life' subject(noun) hai, 'is' linking verb hai aur 'fight' subject complement(noun) aur 'solo' adjective hoga joki 'fight' noun ko qualify kar raha hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Being seriously ill, He was taken to hospital.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'present participle'. Explanation:- 'being seriously ill' yeh poori baat 'he' ke liye likhi hai, jisme 'being' present participle hai, aur 'ill' iska complement(adjective) hai kyunki 'being' participle linking verb se bana hai aur 'seriously' adverb hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: For the next generation of interior architects and design graduates, work opportunities are immense.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'noun'. Explanation:- 'work' adjective hai, 'opportunities' noun hota hai, 'are' linking verb aur 'immense' subject complement (adjective) hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Rakesh is too old to run fast.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'intensifier'. Explanation:- 'is' linking verb hai, 'old' subject complement(adjective) hai, 'too' 'old' ke liye 'adverb' hai, aur 'to run' infinitive hai jo adverb ki tarah kaam kar raha hai. 'intensifier' wo adverb hote hai jo kisi cheez ki intensity badhaayein. saare 'intensifier' 'adverb' hote hai, lekin saare 'adverb' 'intensifier' nahi hote, option mein dono hai, aur 'too' 'old' ki intensity badha raha hai, isliye 'intensifier' option choose karna behtar rahega.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: I got the news of his being arrested.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'gerund'. Explanation:- 'of' preposition hai jiska object 'being' gerund(noun) hai aur 'his' possessive adjective hai aur 'arrested' complement hai 'being' ka, kyunki 'being' linking verb se bana hai jiske baad complement aate hai, toh 'being' yahan gerund hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: I know very well what you want.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Relative pronoun'. Explanation:- yahan yeh 'what' relative pronoun hai. 'What' yahan 'pronoun + conjunction' ka kaam kar raha hai. Aur 'what you want' yeh ek noun clause hai jo 'know' verb ka object ban raha hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: You are paying less attention to your studies these days.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adjective'. Explanation:- 'are paying' H.V. , M.V. hai, 'attention' object(noun) hai, jisko qualify 'less' kar raha hai, isliye 'less' adjective hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Public culture is associated with extremely new civil societies.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'intensifier'. Explanation:- 'with' preposition hai aur 'civil societies' preposition ka object hai, 'new' 'civil socities' ke liye adjective hai, 'extremely' adverb of degree hai 'new' adjective ke liye, 'adverb of degree = intensifier', toh 'extremely' ke liye proper 'intensifier' word ka use karenge.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: We went away after they had left.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'conjunction'. Explanation:- 'after' yahan conjunction hai jo 'we went' first clause aur 'they had' dusre clause ko jod raha hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: They wandered around aimlessly.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adverb'. Explanation:- 'around' yahan preposition nahi hai kyunki preposition ke baad preposition ke object aate hai, lekin 'aimlessly' adverb hai, isliye yahan 'around' adverb hai. 'around' adverb, preposition dono ho sakta hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The conclusions that they came to are highly questionable.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adjective'. Explanation:- 'are' linking verb hai aur 'questionable' subject complement(adjective) aur 'highly' adverb hai, isliye 'questionable' adjective hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: This year marks the quincentenary of Columbus's voyage to America.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Noun'. Explanation:- 'quincentenary' yahan noun hai kyunki article 'a, an, the' ka use 'noun' se pehle hota hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: I still cherish the memories of those far-off days.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adjective'. Explanation:- 'of' preposition hai aur 'days' preposition ka object(noun) hai, aur noun ko qualify adjective karte hai, isliye 'far-off', 'those' dono adjective honge.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: I don't think I'll come on Saturday. I have a lot of work to do. Besides, I don't really like parties.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adverb'. Explanation:- 'besides' yahan preposition nahi hai kyunki preposition ke baad preposition ke object aate hai, lekin yahan object nahi hai, isliye 'besides' yahan adverb hai starting mein likha hai aur comma lagake poore sentence ko qualify/introduce kar raha hai. 'besides' adverb, preposition dono hota hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The bottom line is that we have to make a decision today.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'noun'. Explanation:- 'bottom line' yahan noun hai kyunki 'a, an, the' article ka use noun se pehle hota hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Try to knock that vase over.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adverb'. Explanation:- 'Knock over' ek phrasal verb hoti hai jiska 'over' last mein likha hai, yahan 'over' preposition nahi hai kyunki preposition ka object nahi hai, isliye 'over' yahan adverb hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: I'd like an ice cream. Will you have one too?
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'pronoun'. Explanation:- 'will' H.V. hai, 'you' subject hai, 'have' M.V. hai aur 'one' object(pronoun) hai. isliye 'one' pronoun hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: My parents lent me the money. Otherwise, I could not have afforded the trip.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adverb'. Explanation:- 'otherwise' yahan adverb hai kyunki starting mein likha hai aur comma lagake poore sentence ko qualify/introduce kar raha hai, isliye 'otherwise' adverb ki category mein ayega.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: She wrote me an anguished letter from her prison cell.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adjective'. Explanation:- 'letter' yahan object(noun) hai aur 'anguished' yahan 'letter' noun ko qualify kar raha hai, isliye 'anguished' adjective hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: There is a visitor for you.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'indefinite article'. Explanation:- 'a, an' indefinite article aur 'the' definite article hota hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He headed the Indian freedom struggle which paved the way for non violent struggle for other countries in the 20th century.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'relative pronoun'. Explanation:- 'who, whom, which, that, whose' relative pronoun hote hai jo 'conjunction + pronoun' banne ka kaam karte hai 'which' yahan 'paved' verb ka object hai aur do clause ko jodne ke liye 'conjunction' ka kaam kar raha hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Where there is peace for some time, there will be prosperity.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adverb'. Explanation:- 'where' yahan 'there is peace' phrase ka place bata raha hai, toh jo kisi cheez ka place bataye wo 'adverb of place', isliye 'where' yahan adverb hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Alas ! We have been defeated.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'interjection'. Explanation:- Wo word jo kisi expression yaa feeling ko bataye unhe interjection kehte hai jaise 'Hurrah!, Alas!, Ouch!, Wow!' etc.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: A zero is a zero always.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'noun'. Explanation:- 'is' linking verb hai aur 'zero' subject complement(noun) hai aur 'always' adverb hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: When we entered his home, we saw him sleeping on the floor.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'present participle'. Explanation:- 'saw' verb hai 'him' object hai aur 'sleeping' present participle hai jo object complement ki tarah kaam kar raha hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The lake is one of the most beautiful ones in the country.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adjective'. Explanation:- 'beautiful' adjective hai jo 'ones' pronoun ko qualify kar raha hai. 'most' adverb hai jo 'beautiful' adjective ko qualify kar raha hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Honesty is the best policy.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'uncountable noun'. Explanation:- 'honesty' ek abstract noun hota hai, isliye isse uncountable noun ki category mein rakhte hai.# Determiner = Adjective – Qualitative adjective + Article # Quantifier = Quantitative adjective
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: There is many a slip between the cup and the lip.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'preposition'. Explanation:- 'between' yahan preposition hai aur 'cup and lip' yeh preposition ke object hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Ravi and Megha reached first, but Guha and Saavi finished third.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'conjunction'. Explanation:- 'but' yahan conjunction hai jo 'ravi and megha reached' first clause aur 'guha and saavi finished' dusre clause ko jodne ka kaam kar raha hai. subject+verb ka combination se clause bante hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He is the most sought after teacher in the school.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'determiner'. Explanation:- 'the' adjective ki weaker form hota hai, isliye isse 'determiner' kahenge. 'a, an, the' article ko determiner bhi kehte hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: She sings much better than I do.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adverb'. Explanation:- 'better' yahan adverb hai kyunki 'sings' verb ko qualify kar raha hai, aur 'much' bhi adverb hai jo 'better' ko qualify kar raha hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The story was in all the dailies.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'noun'. Explanation:- 'was' linking verb hai, 'in all the dailies' yeh poore phrase hee complement ki tarah kaam kar raha hai. jisme 'in' preposition hai aur 'dailies' preposition ka object(noun) hai, isliye 'dailies' noun sahi hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Smoking is injurious to health.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'gerund'. Explanation:- 'smoking' yahan subject (noun(gerund)) hai. 'is' linking verb hai aur 'injurious' subject complement(adjective) hai. isliye 'smoking' gerund sahi hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: What made you choose this one rather than the other?
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'pronoun'. Explanation:- 'made' verb hai 'you' object hai, 'choose' object complement(bare infinitive) hai aur 'one' object of bare infinitive(pronoun) hai, aur 'this' demonstrative adjective hai jo 'one' pronoun ko qualify kar raha hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: There is still some water in the bottle.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'determiner'. Explanation:- 'there' introductory subject hai, 'is' linking verb hai, 'water' real subject(noun) hai, aur 'some' yahan adjective hai jo 'water' ko qualify kar raha hai, waise 'some' quantifier hota hai, lekin option mein 'quantifier' nahi hai, isliye 'determiner' ko choose karenge. first preference 'quantifier, quantitative adjective', second preference 'determiner', third 'adjective', jo option mein available hoga usse mark kar lenge.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: I have already told you that you need not come tomorrow.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'auxiliary verb'. Explanation:- 'need' ke baad 'not' likha hai, matlab 'need' modal (helping verb) hoga 'not' adverb hai, 'come' main verb hai, isliye 'need' yahan 'auxiliary(helping) verb' sahi hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Having finished her work, Sharmila left home at 8:00 p.m.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'perfect participle'. Explanation:- 'having finished her work' yeh baat 'sharmila' ke liye likhi hai, aur 'having+v3' ka structure ko perfect participle kehte hai, aur 'infinitive, gerund, participle' yeh semi verb hote hai apna object rakh sakte hai, isliye 'work' perfect participle ka object hai. toh 'having finished' perfect participle hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: My teacher always moves around in her class while teaching
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adverb'. Explanation:- 'around' yahan adverb hai jo 'move' verb ko qualify kar raha hai, agar preposition hota toh iske baad preposition ka object aata.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The cantankerous men of the town roar around the marketplace.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adjective'. Explanation:- 'men' subject(noun) hai 'cantankerous' adjective hai jo 'men' ka quality bata raha hai, determiner mein qualitative adjective nahi aate, isliye 'cantankerous' adjective sahi hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: India is revered as the fountainhead of democracy in the world today.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'noun'. Explanation:- 'the' definite article hai joki noun ke sath lagaya jaata hai, isliye 'fountainhead' yahan subject(noun) hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: She got angry and asked him to go away. Here infinitive is acting as?
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'object'. Explanation:- 'asked' ek di-transitive verb hoti hai, isliye 'him' iska indirect object hai aur 'to go' (infinitive)direct object hai, isliye 'to go' infinitive yahan object hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Having slept for 8 hours, he started his journey again.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'perfect participle'. Explanation:- 'having+v3' ke structure ko perfect participle kehte hai, isliye 'having slept' perfect participle hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: When he saw his father, he started studying Mathematics.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'gerund'. Explanation:- 'started' verb hai aur 'maths' nahi padhegi, balki 'maths' ko padhaya jayega, isliye 'studying' verb ka object(gerund) banega aur 'mathematics' object of gerund.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: In spite of having high fever Radhika kept doing her task.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'preposition'. Explanation:- 'in spite of, despite, instead of etc' yeh preposition hote hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He will help you financially provided you return the money on time.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'conjunction'. Explanation:- 'provided' yaa 'provided that' dono ka matlab 'basharte' hote hai aur yeh conjunction hote hai, jo yahan 'he will' first clause aur 'you return' second clause ko jod raha hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Call me in case there is any problem.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'conjunction'. Explanation:- 'in case' yahan conjunction hai, jo 'call me' first clause aur 'there is any problem' second clause ko jod raha hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: They are used to travelling in trains.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'gerund'. Explanation:- 'are' linking verb hai, isliye 'used' adjective(past participle) hai, 'to' preposition hai aur 'travelling' preposition ka object(gerund) hai. isliye 'travelling' gerund sahi hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He claims to have scored 90% marks in the exam.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'perfect infinitive'. Explanation:- 'to+have+v3' ke structure ko perfect infinitive kehte hai, iska use jab koi kaam ho chuka ho usse dikhaane ke liye infinitive use karna hai, toh perfect infinitive ka use karte hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He felt lonely when his friends went to the party without him.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'adjective'. Explanation:- 'felt' yahan linking verb hai aur 'lonely' subject complement(adjective) hai. isliye 'lonely' adjective sahi hoga. 'smell, taste, feel, sound, look, seems, appear etc.' yeh linking verb hoti hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Her eyes shone like stars in the night.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'simile'. Explanation:- Kisi cheez ka comparison 'like, as' lagake ke kare, toh usse 'simile' kehte hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The phone screamed for attention.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'personification'. Explanation:- Non-human cheez ko human quality dene ko personification kehte hai. jaise phone chillayega nahi.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The silence was so loud, it hurt my ears.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'oxymoron'. Explanation:- Jab do opposite word sath mein aajaye toh 'oxymoron' hota hai, jaise 'silence and loud'. Har baar aisa jaruri nahi ke wo words sath sath aayein.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The clouds wept all day.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'personification'. Explanation:- Non-human cheez ko human quality dene ko personification kehte hai. jaise 'cloud' royenge nahi.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The athlete is a cheetah on the track.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Metaphor'. Explanation:- Kisi cheez ka comparison without 'like, as' ke kare toh wo metaphor hota hai. 'hyperbole' mein bahut jyada badha chada ke batate hai. jaise koi aise baat jo practically possible naa ho door door tak.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The cake is as soft as cotton.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Simile'. Explanation:- Yahan pe cake ka comparison cotton se kiya hai 'as' lagake, isliye yeh 'simile' hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He kicked the bucket last year.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Euphemism'. Explanation:- 'kicked the bucket' ka matlab 'mar jaana', toh kisi harsh baat ko kehna ka light version ko 'euphemism' kehte hai. direct 'die' bolne ki wazaye 'kicked the bucket' kehna.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The kettle hissed as the water boiled.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Onomatopoeia'. Explanation:- Wo word jo kisi sounds se bane ho unhe 'onomatopoeia' kehte hai, jaise 'hissed, buzzed, ticking etc.'
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Why do we drive on parkways and park on driveways?
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Pun'. Explanation:- Pun ka matlab hai 'words se khelna' jaise 'parkways pe drive karna aur driveways pe park kar dena', isliye yeh 'pun' hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The waves crashed angrily against the shore.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'personification'. Explanation:- Non-human cheez ko human quality dene ko personification kehte hai. jaise 'waves' ko gussa nahi ayega.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He is as strong as an ox.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Simile'. Explanation:- Yahan pe comparison ho raha hai 'as' lagake, isliye yeh 'simile' hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The car coughed and spluttered before stopping.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Personification'. Explanation:- Non-human cheez ko human quality dene ko personification kehte hai. jaise 'car' 'cough aur ladhkhadayegi' nahi.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He runs faster than a speeding bullet.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Hyperbole'. Explanation:- Sentence mein kahin gayi baat jyada badha chada ke kahi gayi hai, isliye yeh 'hyperbole' hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The pen is mightier than the sword.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Metaphor'. Explanation:- Yahan pe 'pen' ka comparison 'sword' se ho raha hai bina 'as, like' ke, isliye yeh 'metaphor' hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The teacher gave me mountains of homework.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'hyperbole'. Explanation:- Sentence mein kahi gayi baat jyada badha chada ke kahi gayi hai, isliye yeh 'hyperbole' hoga. kyunki 'homework ka pahaad' nahi ho payega.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The doorbell went ding-dong.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Onomatopoeia'. Explanation:- 'ding-dong' aisa word hai sound se bana hai, isliye yeh 'onomatopoeia' hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He has been called to heaven.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Euphemism'. Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab 'usse swarg bula liya gaya', toh sentence mein 'death' ki baat ko light way mein kaha hai, isliye yeh 'euphemism' hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: She sells shiny seashells on Sundays.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Alliteration'. Explanation:- Aisa sentence jisme consonant sounds ke word ka repetition ho, usse 'alliteration' kehte hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He's in between jobs right now.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Euphemism'. Explanation:- 'between jobs' berozgar (unemployed) kehne ka light tarika hai, isliye yeh 'euphemism' hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The snake slithered silently.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Alliteration'. Explanation:- Aisa sentence jisme consonant sounds ke word ka repetition ho, usse 'alliteration' kehte hai.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The baby's laugh was like music.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Simile'. Explanation:- 'bacche ke hasne' ka comparison 'music' se ho raha hai 'like' lagake, isliye yeh 'simile' hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Her words cut deeper than a knife.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Metaphor'. Explanation:- Sentence mein comparison ho raha hai bina 'as, like' ke, isliye yeh 'metaphor' hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: Life is a puzzle, each piece matters.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Metaphor'. Explanation:- Sentence mein comparison ho raha hai bina 'as, like' ke, isliye yeh 'metaphor' hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The birds chirped cheerfully in the morning.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Onomatopoeia'. Explanation:- 'chirped' aisa word hai jo birds ke awaz se bana hai, isliye yeh 'onomatopoeia' hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He was buried in paperwork.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Hyperbole'. Explanation:- Sentence mein badha chada ke baat kahin gayi hai, isliye 'Hyperbole' hoga. jaise 'wo paperwork mein dafan nahi ho sakta'.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The stars winked at us from the sky.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Personification'. Explanation:- Non-human cheez ko human quality dene ko personification kehte hai. jaise 'stars aankh nahi marenge'.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The customer service was painfully pleasant.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Oxymoron'. Explanation:- 'painful pleasant' yeh do opposite word hai jo ek sath likhe hai, toh isliye isse 'oxymoron' kahenge.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: I'm on a seafood diet. I see food, and I eat it.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Pun'. Explanation:- Pun ka matlab word se khelna jaise 'seafood diet' aur 'see food and I eat it', yahan words se khel raha hai, isliye yeh 'pun' hoga.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: The mountains stood tall, watching over the valley.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Personification'. Explanation:- Non-human cheez ko human quality dene ko personification kehte hai. jaise 'mountains valley pe nazar thodi rakhenge'.
questions.chapter: Parts of Speech + Figure of Speech

questions.question: He calls himself a warrior and he is afraid of fighting.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'Irony'. Explanation:- Irony ka matlab jaise aapne expect kiya ho aur uska opposite ho jaaye, toh sentence mein bataya ki wo warrior (yoddha) hai, lekin ladne se darta hai, isliye yeh 'irony' hoga.
